terms.definition: Insulating materials become charged when rubbed together: electrons are transferred from one to the other.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Only electrons move, never positive charges.

terms.definition: Like charges repel; unlike charges attract.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. This is a non-contact force.

terms.definition: When the p.d. between a charged object and earth is large enough, electrons jump across the gap.
A region around a charged object where another charged object experiences a force; the field is stronger closer to the object.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Field lines point from positive to negative.
